cli.build: release, static musl, the check's target

mboxrd.note: The same messages in the same order, as an mboxrd, by scripts/mboxrd.sh's conventions: the separator line "From MAILER-DAEMON Thu Jan  1 00:00:00 1970" (LF) before each message, one more ">" on each of its lines matching ^>*From , and a blank line (LF) after it; the messages keep their CRLF. Its bytes are a function of the messages alone, so its SHA-256 is the same on every run with these parameters and tools.

record.note: Written by the generator's scale mode (MISE_ENV=fixtures mise run scale); never committed. The messages are a function of the parameters alone: content_sha256 hashes each message's folder path and MIME bytes, in order, and is the same on every run with these parameters and tools. The .pst's bytes are not: PST Builder 1.3.0 writes a random store UID and search keys, so the store has no SHA-256 worth recording.

parameters.bodies: plain only 30%, plain and HTML 60%, HTML only 10%; 1 to 6 paragraphs of 1 to 5 sentences of 4 to 17 words
parameters.large_attachment_bytes: log-uniform from 1048576 to 16777216, one more attachment
